name: Field Museum Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens greet visitors and share science stories. They help young kids in the Crown Family PlayLab and show real specimens at interpretive carts in Stanley Field Hall.
who_can_apply: Current high school students. The page does not list an age rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You can earn volunteer hours.
duration: At least 10 days over the summer; finishing it lets you apply for year-round volunteering later
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Jan 2026 to Feb 28, 2026. Interviews late March or early April; final notice by May 8. The page says check back in early 2027.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page for the application to open in early 2027. Questions: teens@fieldmuseum.org.
notes: The Field Museum says its youth programs may give stipends, public transit vouchers and free admission. Check each program.
